title: 第十章鬼手门掌门出手二第十一章萧书生严查灭门惨案一
content_zh:
暮春时节，江南水乡正是烟雨朦胧之际。萧琰携墨砚回到故乡苏州，将父亲萧长风的灵位迁入修葺一新的萧家祠堂。这日清晨，他正对着祠堂中悬挂的《浩然经》拓本临摹，忽闻院外传来一阵急促的马蹄声，紧接着便是墨砚的惊呼。
萧琰心中一紧，手中玉笔未落，身形已如清风般掠出祠堂。只见院内站着五个身着黑衣的汉子，每人脸上都戴着狰狞的青铜面具，手中长刀泛着冷冽的寒光，而墨砚正被其中两人按在地上，嘴角挂着血迹。
“你们是谁？”萧琰沉声问道，右手悄然握住腰间玉笔，笔尖已隐隐透出金色微光。
为首的黑衣人冷笑一声，声音沙哑如破锣：“萧书生，别来无恙？我们是‘毒蝎’吴天的义子，今日特来为义父报仇！”说罢，他猛地挥手，“杀了他，为义父报仇雪恨！”
两名黑衣人立刻挥刀扑来，刀锋带着呼啸的风声，直取萧琰的要害。萧琰不慌不忙，左脚轻轻一点地面，身体凌空跃起，同时玉笔横扫，笔尖精准地点在两人的手腕上。只听“当啷”两声，两把长刀掉落在地，那两人捂着手腕，痛得惨叫起来。
其余三人见状，对视一眼，同时发动攻击。他们的刀法诡异，刀风之中竟还带着淡淡的毒气，显然是继承了吴天的用毒之术。萧琰眉头微皱，他知道这毒气非同小可，一旦吸入，后果不堪设想。
他迅速后退，同时从怀中取出一张黄纸符咒——这是墨砚之前为他准备的“驱邪符”。萧琰将符咒捏在手中，运力一呵，符咒瞬间燃烧起来，化作一道金色火焰，朝着三名黑衣人飞去。金色火焰蕴含着浩然正气，正好克制他们刀风中的毒气，三人顿时被逼得连连后退。
“墨砚，你没事吧？”萧琰趁机扶起墨砚，关切地问道。
墨砚摇了摇头，咬牙道：“公子，我没事。这些人来者不善，我们得赶紧想办法脱身。”
萧琰点了点头，正欲开口，忽闻院外传来一阵熟悉的笑声：“萧贤侄，别来无恙啊？”
萧琰心中一喜，这声音正是洛千秋！他抬头望去，只见洛千秋一袭玄袍，手持“幽冥鬼手”，正从院外缓缓走来。他身后跟着鬼手门的四大护法，个个气势如虹，显然是收到消息，特意赶来支援。
“洛掌门，你怎么来了？”萧琰惊讶地问道。
洛千秋笑道：“我派去追查吴天余党的弟子传来消息，说有一批黑衣人要来找你麻烦，我便立刻带着人赶来了。没想到，这些小喽啰还真敢在太岁头上动土。”
为首的黑衣人见洛千秋到来，脸色顿时变得惨白。他知道洛千秋的厉害，自己根本不是对手。但他想起义父的仇，还是硬着头皮说道：“洛千秋，这事与你无关，你最好别多管闲事！”
洛千秋冷哼一声，眼神瞬间变得冰冷：“吴天作恶多端，死有余辜。你们这些余孽，竟敢还来寻仇，今日我便替武林除了你们这些祸害！”说罢，他身形一闪，如鬼魅般冲向黑衣人。
“幽冥鬼手”带着强大的幽冥气，直取为首黑衣人的胸口。那黑衣人吓得魂飞魄散，急忙挥刀抵挡。但他的武功与洛千秋相差甚远，只听“咔嚓”一声，长刀被“幽冥鬼手”折断，他本人也被掌力击中，一口鲜血喷出，倒在地上，再也没有了动静。
其余四名黑衣人见状，吓得转身就跑。但鬼手门的四大护法早已布下包围网，他们刚跑出院门，就被护法们拦住。经过一番激战，四名黑衣人全部被制服。
“洛掌门，多谢你及时赶来。”萧琰对着洛千秋拱了拱手，感激地说道。
洛千秋摆了摆手，说道：“萧贤侄，你我之间不必客气。当年之事，我对不住你父亲，如今能为你做点事，也算是弥补我当年的过错。”他顿了顿，继续说道：“不过，这些黑衣人虽然被制服了，但我总觉得事情没有这么简单。吴天的余党不可能只有这么几个人，而且他们的行动似乎有些仓促，不像是早有预谋。”
萧琰闻言，也陷入了沉思。他觉得洛千秋说得有道理，这些黑衣人虽然来势汹汹，但实力却很一般，而且他们的目标似乎只是自己，并没有对萧家祠堂造成太大的破坏。这背后，一定还有更大的阴谋。

几天后，萧琰和洛千秋带着墨砚和几名鬼手门弟子，前往吴天的老巢——黑风寨，追查余党的下落。黑风寨位于苏州城外的一座深山之中，地势险要，易守难攻。
众人来到黑风寨外，只见寨门紧闭，寨墙上站着许多手持兵器的山贼，个个神色警惕。洛千秋观察了一会儿，对萧琰说道：“萧贤侄，这黑风寨看起来防守严密，我们硬闯恐怕会有伤亡。不如我们先派人潜入寨中，打探一下情况，再做打算。”
萧琰点了点头，说道：“洛掌门说得有道理。墨砚，你精通符咒之术，潜入寨中应该不成问题。你去打探一下，看看寨中还有多少余党，他们的首领是谁。”
墨砚领命，从怀中取出一张“隐身符”，贴在身上，瞬间消失在众人眼前。他小心翼翼地潜入黑风寨，避开寨墙上的山贼，朝着寨中的大厅走去。
来到大厅外，墨砚听到里面传来一阵对话声。他屏住呼吸，透过门缝向里面望去，只见大厅中央坐着一个身穿白色长袍的男子，他面容俊美，气质儒雅，看起来不像是一个山贼首领。在他身边，站着几个黑衣人，正是之前袭击萧琰的那伙人的同伙。
只听白衣男子说道：“你们办事怎么这么不小心？竟然让洛千秋和萧琰察觉到了异常。现在他们已经来到了黑风寨外，你们说该怎么办？”
一个黑衣人恭敬地说道：“主人，是我们办事不利，请主人责罚。不过，洛千秋和萧琰虽然厉害，但我们黑风寨地势险要，他们想要攻进来，也不是一件容易的事。我们不如坚守寨门，等他们粮草耗尽，自然会退兵。”
白衣男子摇了摇头，说道：“不行。洛千秋和萧琰都不是等闲之辈，他们肯定不会轻易退兵。而且，我们的计划不能被他们破坏。我已经派人去联络‘影杀门’的人了，只要‘影杀门’的人一到，我们就可以里应外合，一举消灭他们。”
墨砚听到这里，心中一惊。“影杀门”是江湖中一个神秘的杀手组织，他们行事诡秘，杀人如麻，而且从不留活口。如果“影杀门”的人真的来了，那后果不堪设想。
他不敢再停留，悄悄退出大厅，沿着原路返回。回到黑风寨外，墨砚将自己听到的消息告诉了萧琰和洛千秋。
洛千秋听完，脸色变得凝重起来：“没想到‘影杀门’竟然也参与进来了。‘影杀门’的实力非常强大，他们的门主‘无影’更是一个顶尖高手，据说他的武功已经达到了出神入化的境界，江湖中很少有人能与之抗衡。”
萧琰也皱起了眉头，说道：“如果‘影杀门’真的要与我们为敌，那我们就危险了。我们必须想办法阻止他们与黑风寨的人汇合。”
洛千秋点了点头，说道：“没错。萧贤侄，你有什么好办法吗？”
萧琰沉思片刻，说道：“我倒是有一个主意。我们可以兵分两路，一路由我和墨砚带领，去拦截‘影杀门’的人；另一路由洛掌门带领，攻打黑风寨，消灭寨中的余党。这样一来，我们就可以各个击破，阻止他们汇合。”
洛千秋闻言，眼前一亮，说道：“这是一个好主意。不过，‘影杀门’的人非常厉害，你和墨砚去拦截他们，会不会有危险？”
萧琰笑道：“洛掌门放心，我和墨砚自有办法应对。而且，我还有‘浩然笔’和墨砚的符咒之术，应该可以抵挡一阵子。等你们消灭了黑风寨的余党，再来支援我们，应该就没问题了。”
洛千秋见萧琰信心满满，便不再多说，点了点头，说道：“好，就按你说的办。我们现在就兵分两路，行动吧。”
萧琰和墨砚带着几名鬼手门弟子，沿着墨砚打探到的“影杀门”的必经之路，提前来到了一处山谷中埋伏。这处山谷地势狭窄，两侧都是陡峭的悬崖，是拦截“影杀门”的绝佳地点。
众人在山谷中埋伏了大约一个时辰，终于听到远处传来一阵马蹄声。萧琰示意众人做好准备，自己则和墨砚躲在一块巨石后面，观察着动静。
很快，一队身穿黑色劲装的人骑着马，沿着山谷中的小路缓缓走来。他们个个面无表情，眼神冰冷，腰间都佩带着一把短刀，显然就是“影杀门”的人。队伍的最前面，是一个身材高大的男子，他头戴斗笠，脸上蒙着一块黑布，只露出一双锐利的眼睛，看起来应该就是“影杀门”的首领。

“墨砚，准备好符咒。”萧琰低声对墨砚说道。
content_en:
In late spring, the water towns in the south of the Yangtze River are misty and rainy. Xiao Yan returned to her hometown of Suzhou with Mo Yan and moved her father Xiao Changfeng's memorial tablet into the newly renovated Xiao family ancestral hall. Early that morning, while he was copying the rubbings of the "Haoran Sutra" hanging in the ancestral hall, he suddenly heard the sound of rapid horse hooves coming from outside the courtyard, followed by Mo Yan's exclamation.
Xiao Yan's heart tightened, and before the jade pen fell from his hand, his body swept out of the ancestral hall like a breeze. There were five men in black standing in the courtyard, each wearing a ferocious bronze mask on his face, and the long knife in his hand glowed with cold light. Mo Yan was being pushed to the ground by two of them, with blood stains on the corners of his mouth.
"Who are you?" Xiao Yan asked in a deep voice. He quietly held the jade pen at his waist with his right hand, and the tip of the pen had a faint golden light.
The leader of the men in black sneered, his voice hoarse as a broken gong: "Scholar Xiao, are you okay? We are the adopted sons of 'Venomous Scorpion' Wu Tian, and we are here to avenge our adoptive father today!" After that, he waved his hand fiercely, "Kill him and avenge his adoptive father!"
The two men in black immediately rushed towards Xiao Yan with their swords, and with the sound of whistling wind, the blades hit Xiao Yan's vital part. Xiao Yan didn't panic, lightly touched the ground with his left foot, leaped into the air, and at the same time swept the jade pen across, and the tip of the pen was accurately placed on the wrists of the two. There were just two "clangs" and two long knives fell to the ground. The two men covered their wrists and screamed in pain.
When the other three saw this, they looked at each other and attacked at the same time. Their sword skills were strange, and there was a faint poisonous air in the sword wind. They obviously inherited Wu Tian's poison-using skills. Xiao Yan frowned slightly. He knew that this poisonous gas was not trivial. Once inhaled, the consequences would be disastrous.
He quickly backed away and took out a yellow paper charm from his arms - this was the "exorcism charm" that Mo Yan had prepared for him. Xiao Yan held the talisman in his hand, and with a flick of his luck, the talisman burned instantly and turned into a golden flame, flying towards the three men in black. The golden flame contained great righteousness, which just restrained the poisonous energy in their sword wind, and the three of them were immediately forced to retreat.
"Mo Yan, are you okay?" Xiao Yan took the opportunity to help Mo Yan up and asked with concern.
Mo Yan shook his head and gritted his teeth and said, "Sir, I'm fine. These people come with bad intentions. We must find a way to escape quickly."
Xiao Yan nodded and was about to speak when he suddenly heard a familiar laughter coming from outside the hospital: "Nephew Xiao, are you okay?"
Xiao Yan was delighted, this voice was Luo Qianqiu! He looked up and saw Luo Qianqiu, dressed in a mysterious robe and holding a "Ghost Hand of the Netherworld", walking slowly from outside the courtyard. Behind him were the four guardians of the Ghost Hand Sect, all of whom were as powerful as a rainbow. They had obviously received the news and came specifically to support him.
"Master Luo, why are you here?" Xiao Yan asked in surprise.
Luo Qianqiu said with a smile: "The disciples I sent to track down Wu Tianyu's party sent news that a group of men in black are coming to trouble you, so I immediately came with my people. I didn't expect that these little minions would really dare to disturb Tai Sui."
When the man in black at the head saw Luo Qianqiu's arrival, his face suddenly turned pale. He knew how powerful Luo Qianqiu was, and he was no match for him. But he wanted to take revenge on his father, so he bit the bullet and said: "Luo Qianqiu, this matter has nothing to do with you, you'd better not meddle in other people's business!"
Luo Qianqiu snorted coldly, and his eyes instantly turned cold: "Wu Tian has done many evil things, and he deserves to die. How dare you, the remnants, come to seek revenge. Today I will eliminate these scourges for the martial arts world like you!" After that, he flashed and rushed towards the man in black like a ghost.
The "Netherworld Ghost Hand" brought powerful Netherworld Qi directly to the chest of the leading man in black. The man in black was so frightened that he quickly waved his sword to resist. But his martial arts was far from Luo Qianqiu. With a "click" sound, the long knife was broken by the "Netherworld Ghost Hand", and he himself was hit by the force of his palm. A mouthful of blood spurted out, and he fell to the ground, and there was no more movement.
When the other four men in black saw this, they turned around and ran away in fright. But the ghost hand doorThe four guardians had already set up a siege net. As soon as they ran out of the courtyard, they were stopped by the guardians. After a fierce battle, all four men in black were subdued.
"Master Luo, thank you for coming in time." Xiao Yan cupped his hands towards Luo Qianqiu and said gratefully.
Luo Qianqiu waved his hand and said: "Nephew Xiao Xian, there is no need to be polite between you and me. I couldn't forgive your father for what happened back then. Now I can do something for you, which can be regarded as making up for my mistakes back then." He paused and continued: "However, although these men in black were subdued, I always feel that the matter is not that simple. Wu Tian's remnant party cannot only have such a few people, and their actions seem to be hasty and do not seem to have been premeditated."
Xiao Yan also fell into deep thought after hearing this. He felt that what Luo Qianqiu said made sense. Although these men in black were menacing, their strength was average. Moreover, their target seemed to be only themselves, and they did not cause much damage to the Xiao family ancestral hall. There must be a bigger conspiracy behind this.
A few days later, Xiao Yan and Luo Qianqiu took Mo Yan and several Guishou Sect disciples to Wu Tian's home base, Heifeng Village, to track down the whereabouts of the remaining party. Black Wind Village is located in a deep mountain outside Suzhou City. The terrain is dangerous and easy to defend but difficult to attack.
When everyone came to the outside of Heifeng Village, they saw that the gate of the village was closed, and there were many bandits with weapons standing on the walls of the village, all of them looking wary. Luo Qianqiu observed for a while and said to Xiao Yan: "Nephew Xiao Xian, this Black Wind Stronghold seems to be well-defended. We may suffer casualties if we forcefully break in. Why don't we send people to sneak into the stronghold first, inquire about the situation, and then make plans."
Xiao Yan nodded and said: "Master Luo is right. Mo Yan, you are proficient in the art of spells, so it shouldn't be a problem to sneak into the stronghold. Go and find out how many remaining parties there are in the stronghold and who their leader is."
Mo Yan took the order, took out an "invisibility charm" from his arms, stuck it on his body, and disappeared in front of everyone in an instant. He carefully sneaked into Heifeng Village, avoiding the bandits on the wall, and walked towards the hall in the village.
Arriving outside the hall, Mo Yan heard a conversation coming from inside. He held his breath and looked inside through the crack in the door. He saw a man wearing a white robe sitting in the center of the hall. He had a handsome face and elegant temperament. He did not look like a bandit leader. Beside him, stood several men in black, who were the accomplices of the group that attacked Xiao Yan before.
Just listen to the man in white say: "Why are you so careless? Luo Qianqiu and Xiao Yan actually noticed something unusual. Now that they have arrived outside Black Wind Stronghold, what do you think they should do?"
A man in black said respectfully: "Master, we have done something wrong. Please punish us. However, although Luo Qianqiu and Xiao Yan are powerful, the terrain of our Black Wind Village is dangerous, and it is not easy for them to invade. We might as well stick to the gate of the village and wait until they run out of food and supplies, and then they will naturally retreat."
The man in white shook his head and said, "No. Luo Qianqiu and Xiao Yan are not easy-going people, and they will definitely not retreat easily. Moreover, our plan cannot be destroyed by them. I have already sent someone to contact the people from the Shadow Killing Sect. As soon as the people from the Shadow Killing Sect arrive, we can cooperate inside and outside to eliminate them in one fell swoop."
Mo Yan was shocked when he heard this. The "Shadow Killer Sect" is a mysterious killer organization in the world. They act in secret, kill like crazy, and never leave anyone alive. If the people from the "Shadow Killing Sect" really come, the consequences will be disastrous.
He didn't dare to stay any longer, so he quietly exited the hall and returned along the original path. Back outside Black Wind Village, Mo Yan told Xiao Yan and Luo Qianqiu what he had heard.
After hearing this, Luo Qianqiu's face became solemn: "I didn't expect that the 'Shadow Killing Sect' would also participate. The 'Shadow Killing Sect' is very powerful, and their sect leader 'Wuying' is a top master. It is said that his martial arts has reached the level of ecstasy.The realm of transformation, few people in the world can compete with it. "
Xiao Yan also frowned and said: "If the 'Shadow Killing Sect' really wants to become our enemy, then we will be in danger. We must find a way to prevent them from joining up with the people from Black Wind Village. "
Luo Qianqiu nodded and said, "That's right. Nephew Xiao Xian, do you have any good ideas? "
Xiao Yan thought for a moment and said, "I do have an idea. We can divide our troops into two groups. One group will be led by Mo Yan and I to intercept the people from the 'Shadow Killing Sect'; the other group will be led by Leader Luo to attack the Black Wind Stronghold and eliminate the remaining members of the stronghold. In this way, we can defeat them individually and prevent them from joining together. "
When Luo Qianqiu heard this, his eyes lit up and he said: "This is a good idea. However, the people from the ‘Shadow Kill Sect’ are very powerful. Will it be dangerous for you and Mo Yan to intercept them? "
Xiao Yan smiled and said: "Don't worry, Master Luo, Mo Yan and I have our own ways to deal with it. Moreover, I also have the spell skills of ‘Haoran Brush’ and Mo Yan, which should be able to withstand it for a while. Once you eliminate the remnants of Heifeng Village and come back to support us, it should be fine. "
Seeing Xiao Yan's confidence, Luo Qianqiu said no more, nodded and said, "Okay, I'll do as you say. Let's split up into two groups and take action now. "
Xiao Yan and Mo Yan took several disciples of the Ghost Hand Sect and followed the path that Mo Yan had discovered to the "Shadow Kill Sect" and arrived in a valley in advance to ambush. The terrain of this valley is narrow and there are steep cliffs on both sides. It is an excellent place to intercept the "Shadow Killing Gate".
Everyone waited in ambush in the valley for about an hour, and finally heard the sound of horse hooves in the distance. Xiao Yan signaled everyone to get ready, while he and Mo Yan hid behind a boulder and observed the movement.
Soon, a group of people wearing black costumes rode horses and walked slowly along the path in the valley. All of them had expressionless faces, cold eyes, and all wore short knives at their waists. They were obviously members of the "Shadow Killing Sect". At the front of the team was a tall man. He was wearing a bamboo hat and a black cloth covering his face. Only his sharp eyes were exposed. He looked like he should be the leader of the "Shadow Killing Sect".
"Mo Yan, prepare the spell. "Xiao Yan whispered to Mo Yan.
